overview: Two isolated Garbani Channel ankle bones, UCMP 197509 and UCMP 197517, are attributed to Purgatorius through comparative analyses. Their joint surfaces support a mobile ankle and possible foot inversion, but they are not associated with teeth and do not establish a named dental species, crown-Primate membership or direct ancestry.
overviewZh: Garbani Channel 的两件孤立踝骨 UCMP 197509 和 UCMP 197517，经比较分析被归入 Purgatorius。关节面支持踝部活动度较高及足部可能内翻的解释；但骨骼未与牙齿关联，不能确认其属于某个具名牙齿种，也不能据此确立冠群灵长类成员资格或直接祖先关系。

ecology.diet: Diet cannot be tested from the isolated ankle bones.
ecology.habitat: The Garbani Channel setting identifies the fossil locality; it does not by itself establish the animal’s habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Ankle mobility and an inverted-foot capability are inferred from tarsal form.
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied; body mass is estimated by comparison rather than measured.
ecology.guild: An arboreal locomotor interpretation is possible, but diet remains unknown.
ecology.dietZh: 孤立的踝骨无法检验食性。
ecology.habitatZh: Garbani Channel 的沉积环境标示了化石地点；仅凭这一点无法确定该动物的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 踝部活动能力和足部内翻能力是根据跗骨形态推断的。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型小；体重是通过比较估算，而非直接测量。
ecology.guildZh: 其运动方式可能适于树栖，但食性仍未知。

traits: Mobile upper ankle joint
Foot inversion inferred from tarsal anatomy
Isolated astragalus and calcaneus attributed by comparison
evidenceSummary: UCMP 197509 and UCMP 197517 are isolated tarsals attributed through comparative regressions and matrices. The 65.2–64.4 Ma interval is the bounded late-Puercan sample context, not a genus-wide range, crown-Primate age or direct date on either bone.

title.en: Two bones, not a skeleton
title.zh: 两块骨骼，并非完整骨架

text.en: The Garbani Channel sample consists of an astragalus and a calcaneus attributed to Purgatorius. Neither bone is associated with teeth, so the evidence is narrower than a complete species account.
text.zh: Garbani Channel 样本包括一块距骨和一块跟骨，研究将它们归入 Purgatorius。两块骨骼都没有与牙齿关联，因此证据范围比完整物种描述更窄。

title.en: What the ankle can suggest
title.zh: 踝部形态能提示什么

text.en: Measurements and joint surfaces place the bones toward the mobile end of the comparison sample. That anatomy supports possible foot inversion and branch use, but it does not directly show climbing or the animal’s daily routine.
text.zh: 测量值与关节面比较显示，这些骨骼位于样本中踝部活动度较高的一端。这支持足部可能内翻、可能利用树枝的解释，但没有直接显示攀爬行为或日常活动。

title.en: Attribution is not ancestry
title.zh: 标本归属不等于祖先关系

text.en: Comparative regressions and phylogenetic matrices support the attribution to Purgatorius. They do not identify a dental species, establish membership in crown Primates or demonstrate a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 比较回归与系统发育矩阵支持将骨骼归入 Purgatorius，但不能确定其所属的牙齿种、确立冠群灵长类成员资格，也无法证明直接祖先关系。

title.en: Chester et al. (2015). Oldest known euarchontan tarsals and affinities of Paleocene Purgatorius to Primates.
title.zh: Chester 等（2015）：已知最早的灵长总目踝骨及古新世 Purgatorius 与灵长类的亲缘关系。

scope.en: Isolated Garbani Channel tarsals and comparative functional and taxonomic analyses; no associated dental skeleton.
scope.zh: 研究对象为 Garbani Channel 孤立跗骨及其比较功能、分类分析；没有与牙齿相连的骨架。

readerLimitations.en: The 65.2–64.4 Ma interval is the late-Puercan sample context, not a direct date on either bone or a genus-wide range. Tarsal attribution and arboreal movement are comparative interpretations; the sample does not resolve diet, population ecology or a direct place in primate ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 65.2–64.4 Ma 是晚 Puercan 期样本背景，不是两件骨骼的直接测年，也不是该属的完整延限。跗骨归属与树栖运动能力都是比较解释；样本无法确定食性、种群生态或其在灵长类祖先关系中的直接位置。

evidenceSummaryZh: UCMP 197509 和 UCMP 197517 是孤立的跗骨，通过比较回归和特征矩阵归属到该类群。65.2–64.4 Ma 是限定的晚普尔加托里期样本背景，并非该属的整体年代范围、冠群灵长类的年代，或对任一骨骼的直接测年。
traitsZh: 根据跗骨解剖结构推断其足部可内翻。
通过比较归属的孤立距骨与跟骨。

overview: Part and counterpart of one juvenile skeleton preserve unusually complete anatomy, soft-tissue outline and gut contents, while preparation history and phylogenetic placement require explicit qualification.

ecology.diet: Plant material inferred from preserved gut contents
ecology.habitat: Messel lake ecosystem; habitual microhabitat remains inferred
ecology.locomotion: Arboreal quadrupedal interpretation from hands, feet and limbs
ecology.bodySize: Juvenile individual; adult body size cannot be read directly
ecology.guild: Small arboreal plant-eater inferred from one juvenile

traits: Complete tail and articulated limbs
Hands and right foot preserved
Soft-tissue outline and gut contents
evidenceSummary: PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are opposite slabs of one skeleton. Fabricated portions of plate B were disclosed, and no feature makes the specimen a demonstrated anthropoid ancestor.

title.en: Two slabs, one juvenile skeleton
title.zh: 两块石板，同一具幼年骨架

text.en: At Messel, PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are the two sides of one juvenile skeleton, not two animals. Together the slabs preserve a continuous outline with limbs, hands, feet and tail. Comparing the counterpart surfaces helps distinguish the animal’s anatomy from gaps and distortions introduced during burial or preparation.
text.zh: 梅塞尔的 PMO 214.214 与 WDC-MG-210 是同一具幼年骨架的两面，不是两只动物。合看两块石板，可见较连续的身体轮廓、四肢、手、足和尾部。对照正反面，有助于把动物本身的解剖结构同埋藏或制备造成的缺损、变形区分开来。

title.en: Gut contents meet a juvenile life stage
title.zh: 肠道线索必须放在幼年阶段中理解

text.en: The description records a soft-tissue outline and plant material in the gut region, as well as teeth and limbs. Those clues make this individual unusually informative, but it was juvenile: its adult size and proportions cannot be read directly from the skeleton. Plant material supports a limited dietary interpretation for this animal, not a complete menu for the species.
text.zh: 描述记录了软组织轮廓和肠道区域的植物残留，也记录了牙齿与四肢。这些线索让个体格外有信息量，但它尚处幼年阶段：不能直接从这具骨架读出成体体型或比例。植物残留只支持对这只动物饮食的有限解释，并非整个物种的完整食谱。

title.en: Anatomical completeness does not settle the tree
title.zh: 骨架完整，也不能决定系统树位置

text.en: The original description discloses fabricated preparation material on part of the counterplate. Darwinius’s anatomical combination has entered debates about adapiforms and anthropoid relationships, yet one complete-looking skeleton cannot settle a branching history or demonstrate a human ancestor. Preparation history, preserved anatomy and phylogenetic placement answer different questions.
text.zh: 原始描述披露了反板部分区域含有人工制备材料。Darwinius 的特征组合曾用于讨论适应猴类与拟人猿类的关系，但一具保存较完整的骨架不能独自确定分支历史，也不能证明它是人类祖先。标本制备、保存解剖和系统发育位置是不同问题。

title.en: Franzen et al. (2009). Complete Primate Skeleton from the Middle Eocene of Messel in Germany: Morphology and Paleobiology.
title.zh: Franzen 等（2009）：德国梅塞尔中始新世的完整灵长类骨架：形态与古生物学。

scope.en: The Messel juvenile part-and-counterpart holotype, its described anatomy, preparation disclosure and proposed paleobiology.
scope.zh: 梅塞尔幼体正反模正模及其解剖描述、制备说明和古生物学解释。

readerLimitations.en: This guide follows one juvenile holotype and its original description. It does not provide a population-level account, a direct adult body-size estimate, or a settled phylogenetic position; preparation details and interpretations should be read with the specimen record.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文围绕一件幼年正模及其原始描述展开，不是种群层面的综述，也不提供直接的成体体型估计或无争议的系统发育位置；解读其形态时应同时注意标本与制备记录。

commonNameZh: 狭鼻猴干群萨达猴标本
overview: Holotype SGS-UM 2009-002 is a partial cranium combining crown-catarrhine features with no diagnostic ape or Old World monkey specialization in the published matrix.

ecology.diet: Diet inferred from preserved dentition; direct feeding evidence absent
ecology.habitat: Shumaysi depositional setting; habitual habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the partial cranium
ecology.bodySize: Known from a partial adult cranium; body mass is model dependent
ecology.guild: Dietary guild unresolved beyond dental inference

traits: Partial face, palate and dentition
Tubular ectotympanic
Matrix-defined stem-catarrhine character combination
evidenceSummary: The holotype and a 36-character matrix support a stem-catarrhine test, but the 29–28 Ma age is biochronological and does not directly date the crown split or identify an ancestor.

title.en: What survives in the partial skull
title.zh: 部分头骨保存了哪些信息

text.en: Saadanius is represented by the partial adult cranium SGS-UM 2009-002 from the middle Shumaysi Formation of western Saudi Arabia. The face, palate, teeth and ear region survive, while most of the skeleton does not. This Oligocene specimen therefore offers a rare but anatomically limited view of a catarrhine-grade primate from a region with few comparable fossils.
text.zh: Saadanius 由一件成年个体的部分头骨代表：正模 SGS-UM 2009-002，出自沙特阿拉伯西部 Shumaysi 组中部。面部、腭部、牙齿和耳区得以保存，骨架其余大部分则未见。这件渐新世标本提供了少见但解剖范围有限的狭鼻猴类观察材料，产自同类化石较少的地区。

title.en: How the character combination is placed
title.zh: 特征矩阵如何给出系统位置

text.en: The authors compared the cranium with living and fossil catarrhines in a 36-character matrix. Saadanius has catarrhine-associated features, including a tubular ectotympanic, a bone of the ear region, but lacks the diagnostic specializations used for crown apes or Old World monkeys. The analysis places it on the stem side of the catarrhine split; that result depends on the coded characters and comparison set.
text.zh: 作者用 36 项性状矩阵将头骨同现生及化石狭鼻猴类比较。Saadanius 具有狭鼻猴类相关特征，包括耳区的管状鼓骨，却缺少识别冠群类人猿或旧世界猴所用的诊断性特化。分析把它置于狭鼻猴分化的干群一侧；结果取决于编码的性状和比较对象。

title.en: The fossil age does not date the split
title.zh: 化石年代并未测出分化时间

text.en: The paper assigns the fossil an age of roughly 29–28 million years from the formation’s biochronology. That interval helps frame when catarrhine evolution may have been under way, but it is not a direct measurement of the ape–Old World monkey split. Its stem-group placement also does not identify this individual or species as their direct ancestor.
text.zh: 论文依据该组的生物年代学，将化石置于约 2,900 万至 2,800 万年前。这个区间有助于讨论狭鼻猴类演化可能发生的时段，却不是对类人猿与旧世界猴分化时间的直接测量。干群位置也不能证明这一个体或物种是两支的直系祖先。

title.en: Zalmout et al. (2010). New Oligocene primate from Saudi Arabia and the divergence of apes and Old World monkeys.
title.zh: Zalmout 等（2010）：沙特阿拉伯新发现的渐新世灵长类与类人猿、旧世界猴的分化。

scope.en: Partial Shumaysi Formation cranium, the paper’s character matrix and biochronological placement.
scope.zh: Shumaysi 组部分头骨、论文中的特征矩阵及生物年代学定位。

readerLimitations.en: The account rests on one partial cranium and one published character analysis. Biochronological age is not a direct date for a divergence, and the proposed stem-catarrhine position does not establish direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文依据一件部分头骨和一项已发表的特征分析。生物年代学年龄不是分化事件的直接测年；提出的狭鼻猴干群位置也不能证明直接祖先关系。

overview: This account follows small dental samples attributed to Teilhardina in three sections correlated across the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM). Their sampled order—from Asia to Europe to North America—is a reconstruction from separate local records, not a tracked migrating population.

ecology.diet: Dental samples do not directly record diet
ecology.habitat: Section and carbon-isotope context, not habitual habitat
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the dental samples
ecology.bodySize: Body mass is not directly estimated from the reported sequence
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved from these samples

traits: Separately catalogued dental samples
Dental comparisons across three PETM sections
No associated postcranial skeleton
evidenceSummary: Smith, Rose and Gingerich compare the teeth and correlated sections on pp. 11223–11227 (Figures 1–3 and Supporting Tables). The proposed order depends on species identifications and age correlations; it is not a direct migration route, a global first-appearance date or a claim of direct ancestry.

title.en: Teeth from three distant sections
title.zh: 来自三个遥远地层剖面的牙齿

text.en: The paper compares small dental samples from the Hengyang Basin in China, Dormaal in Belgium and Wyoming’s Bighorn Basin. Each comes from a different section. Linking them into one geographic sequence therefore depends on both the species identifications and the correlation of the rock layers; the fossils do not record one group travelling between the sites.
text.zh: 论文比较了中国衡阳盆地、比利时 Dormaal 和美国怀俄明州 Bighorn 盆地的少量牙齿样本。它们来自不同地层剖面。要将这些样本排成地理序列，必须依赖物种鉴定和地层对比；化石本身并没有记录同一群动物从一地迁往另一地。

title.en: An ordered record around the PETM
title.zh: PETM 前后的有序化石记录

text.en: The authors compare the teeth and section ages with the PETM, a major warming event about 56 million years ago. Their correlations place the sampled Teilhardina records first in Asia, then Europe and North America over a short interval. This is an order among sampled fossils in correlated strata, not a continuous population history.
text.zh: 作者将牙齿比较和剖面年代与约 5600 万年前的古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）联系起来。对比结果把所采样的 Teilhardina 化石依次放在亚洲、欧洲和北美的短时间窗内。这是对比地层中采样化石的先后顺序，不是连续种群史。

title.en: Dispersal is an interpretation
title.zh: 扩散是对记录顺序的解释

text.en: Smith, Rose and Gingerich interpret the sequence as rapid geographic dispersal. The route itself is not preserved: species assignments, fossil sampling and age correlations all affect the result. Teeth alone do not show how the animals moved or where they lived, and the earliest sampled record is not necessarily the group’s global origin.
text.zh: Smith、Rose 与 Gingerich 将这一顺序解释为快速地理扩散。化石并未直接保存迁徙路线；物种鉴定、采样和年代对比都会影响结论。牙齿不能说明动物如何移动或栖居，最早采样记录也未必是该类群的全球起源。

title.en: Smith, Rose & Gingerich (2006). Rapid Asia–Europe–North America geographic dispersal of earliest Eocene primate Teilhardina during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum.
title.zh: Smith、Rose 与 Gingerich（2006）：古新世—始新世极热事件期间最早始新世灵长类 Teilhardina 在亚洲—欧洲—北美的快速地理扩散。

scope.en: Dental samples from three correlated sections and the paper’s PETM age and dispersal interpretation.
scope.zh: 三个对比地层剖面的牙齿样本，以及论文的 PETM 年代与扩散解释。

readerLimitations.en: This account covers a small dental sample from three correlated sections. Its geographic order depends on identification and dating; it is not a continuous migration record, a complete ecological study or a directly measured global first appearance.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文介绍来自三个相关联地层剖面的少量牙齿样本。其地理顺序取决于鉴定和年代对比；它不是连续迁徙记录、完整生态研究或直接测得的全球首次出现。

overviewZh: 本条依据归入 Teilhardina 的小型牙齿样本，这些样本来自三个彼此对比的地层剖面，横跨古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）。由亚洲到欧洲再到北美的取样顺序，是根据彼此独立的地方记录作出的重建，并非对同一迁徙种群的连续追踪。
evidenceSummaryZh: Smith、Rose 和 Gingerich 在第 11223–11227 页（图 1–3 及补充表）比较了牙齿和对应地层剖面。所提出的先后顺序取决于物种鉴定和年代对比；它不是直接的迁徙路线、全球最早出现时间，也不表示直接祖先关系。

commonNameZh: 莫罗古猿姿势骨骼样本
overview: Two separate fossils, shoulder specimen MUZM 60 from Moroto I and femur MUZM 80 from Moroto II, anchor this Morotopithecus bishopi account. They are not one associated skeleton. The study compares each bone to investigate early Miocene hominoid movement.

ecology.diet: These two postcranial fossils provide no direct evidence of diet.
ecology.habitat: The Moroto localities give geological context; they do not directly establish the animal’s habitual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Comparative functional analysis supports a mixed arboreal repertoire. This is a reconstruction from bones, not observed movement.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates come from comparisons of the postcranial specimens and apply to this sample.
ecology.guild: Locomotion alone does not resolve the animal’s ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 这两件颅后骨骼化石没有提供直接的食性证据。
ecology.habitatZh: Moroto 化石地点提供地质背景，但不能直接确定该动物的习惯性生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 比较功能分析支持其具有多样的树栖运动方式。这是根据骨骼作出的重建，并非观察到的运动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型估计来自对这些颅后骨骼标本的比较，仅适用于这批样本。
ecology.guildZh: 仅凭运动方式不能确定该动物的生态类群。

traits: Shoulder anatomy in the Moroto sample
Femoral anatomy in the Moroto sample
Shoulder and femur belong to separate MUZM specimens
evidenceSummary: MacLatchy and colleagues compare MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 on pages 159–183, Figures 1–12 and Tables 1–10. Locality attribution, movement reconstruction and evolutionary placement are separate inferences; the bones do not show observed behavior or direct ancestry.

title.en: Shoulder and thigh from separate finds
title.zh: 肩部与大腿骨来自不同发现

text.en: The paper discusses two finds: shoulder material MUZM 60 from Moroto I and femur MUZM 80 from Moroto II in Uganda. They were not found together as one skeleton. Each bone is compared with other primates, while the locality records help frame the analysis. The species name Morotopithecus bishopi therefore should not be mistaken for one associated individual.
text.zh: 论文讨论两件化石：来自 Moroto I 的肩部材料 MUZM 60，以及来自乌干达 Moroto II 的股骨 MUZM 80。它们并非同一具骨架。研究分别将两块骨骼与其他灵长类比较，再利用地点记录说明样本背景。因此，物种名 Morotopithecus bishopi 不能让人误以为这些骨头来自同一个个体。

title.en: What the bones suggest about movement
title.zh: 骨骼怎样提示运动方式

text.en: The study compares the shoulder and femur to test possible movement. Together, their form supports a varied arboreal repertoire rather than a single label based on one bone. This is a functional reconstruction from fossil anatomy and comparison with living and extinct primates. No one observed Morotopithecus moving, and the bones do not preserve its everyday behavior.
text.zh: 研究比较肩部和股骨形态，检验可能的运动方式。两件材料共同支持多样的树栖运动能力，而不是依据单块骨头贴上单一标签。这是从化石解剖结构并与现生、灭绝灵长类比较后得出的功能重建。没有人直接观察过 Morotopithecus 活动，这些骨骼也不记录它的日常行为。

title.en: Movement and ancestry are different questions
title.zh: 运动方式与祖先关系是不同问题

text.en: A locomotor model does not by itself determine a place on the primate family tree. These two postcranial bones do not form a complete skeleton, establish diet or habitat, or show that Morotopithecus directly gave rise to living apes. The paper’s conclusion is a movement model for a limited sample; missing anatomy remains unknown.
text.zh: 运动模型本身不能决定它在灵长类谱系树中的位置。这两件头后骨骼既不构成完整骨架，也不能确定饮食或栖地，更不能证明 Morotopithecus 是现生类人猿的直接祖先。论文结论是针对有限样本提出的运动模型；缺失的解剖信息仍然未知。

title.en: MacLatchy et al. (2000). Postcranial functional morphology of Morotopithecus bishopi, with implications for the evolution of modern ape locomotion.
title.zh: MacLatchy 等（2000）：Morotopithecus bishopi 的附肢功能形态及其对现代类人猿运动演化的启示。

scope.en: Comparative analysis of separate shoulder and femoral specimens from Moroto I and II; functional reconstruction is specimen bounded.
scope.zh: 比较 Moroto I、II 的分离肩部与股骨标本；功能重建受具体标本范围限制。

readerLimitations.en: This account follows a functional study of two separate postcranial fossils. It does not provide a complete skeleton, direct behavioral observations, a species-wide ecological profile or proof of direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页依据一项研究两件分离头后骨骼的功能分析，不是完整骨架、直接行为观察、物种整体生态档案或直接祖先关系的证明。

overviewZh: 两件彼此分离的化石——来自 Moroto I 的肩部标本 MUZM 60 和来自 Moroto II 的股骨 MUZM 80——构成 Morotopithecus bishopi 这项记述的依据。二者并非同一关联骨架的一部分。该研究分别比较两块骨骼，以探讨中新世早期人猿类的运动方式。
evidenceSummaryZh: MacLatchy 等人在第 159–183 页、图 1–12 和表 1–10 中比较了 MUZM 60 与 MUZM 80。地点归属、运动方式重建和演化位置是彼此独立的推断；骨骼并未显示直接观察到的行为或直接祖先关系。
traitsZh: Moroto 样本中的肩部解剖特征。
Moroto 样本中的股骨解剖特征。
肩部和股骨来自不同的 MUZM 标本。

commonNameZh: 布里杰组北猴足部样本
overview: The semi-articulated foot AMNH 143612/143640 from Wyoming's Bridger B locality preserves toe bones that can be assigned to individual digits. Comparing those bones led researchers to infer a grooming claw on digit two of *Notharctus*. The claw's function is inferred from anatomy; grooming itself was not observed. This 50–48.5 Ma locality sample does not establish the genus's full range, a direct ancestor or membership in the living-primate crown group.

ecology.diet: The foot does not record diet.
ecology.habitat: The Bridger Formation locates the fossils, but not the animal's habitual microhabitat.
ecology.locomotion: Foot proportions allow functional comparison; locomotion was not observed.
ecology.bodySize: This foot sample does not establish a population-wide body-size estimate.
ecology.guild: The foot anatomy does not identify an ecological role.
ecology.habitatZh: Bridger 组确定了化石产地，但没有确定该动物通常利用的微生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 足部比例可用于功能比较；运动方式并未被直接观察。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这批足部样本不能确定种群层面的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 足部解剖特征无法确定其生态作用。

traits: Semi-articulated foot represented by AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640
Toe bones assigned to individual digits
Grooming-claw function inferred for digit two
evidenceSummary: The named foot preserves phalanges that can be compared by toe. The proposed grooming claw on digit two is a functional interpretation, not an observation of grooming or a condition shown for every *Notharctus*.

title.en: One foot under two museum numbers
title.zh: 一个足部样本，两个馆藏编号

text.en: The study examines a semi-articulated *Notharctus* foot from Wyoming's Bridger Formation, catalogued as AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640. Several toe bones remain positioned well enough to compare individual digits. These two catalogue numbers refer to one bounded foot sample, not every *Notharctus* foot or a complete skeleton.
text.zh: 研究考察了怀俄明 Bridger 组的一只半关节连接 *Notharctus* 足部，馆藏编号为 AMNH 143612 和 AMNH 143640。几块趾骨仍保留位置，因此能够按不同脚趾逐一比较。两个编号指向的是一个有明确范围的足部样本，不代表所有 *Notharctus* 足部或完整骨架。

title.en: Which digit had a grooming claw?
title.zh: 哪个脚趾可能有梳理爪？

text.en: Comparing the toe bones led the authors to infer that the grooming claw was on digit two, rather than the digit-one position often proposed for adapiforms. The inference rests on the shape and joint relationships of phalanges assigned to particular digits. It is a functional interpretation of the bones, not a record of *Notharctus* grooming.
text.zh: 作者比较趾骨后，推断梳理爪位于第二趾，而非过去常为适应猴类提出的第一趾位置。判断依据是分属不同脚趾的趾骨形态与关节关系。这是对骨骼功能的解释，不是对 *Notharctus* 实际梳理行为的观察。

title.en: What a foot bone cannot show
title.zh: 足骨不能记录的行为

text.en: The proposed claw position can be compared with feet of other primates, but the fossil does not show how often the animal groomed, why it groomed, or whether every individual had the same claw. One foot tests a functional hypothesis; it cannot settle behaviour across the genus or ancestry.
text.zh: 推测的梳理爪位置可与其他灵长类的足部比较，但化石不能显示动物梳理的频率、原因，也不能证明每个个体都具有相同爪位。一只足部可以检验功能假说，却不能决定整个属的行为或祖先关系。

title.en: Maiolino et al. (2012). Evidence for a Grooming Claw in a North American Adapiform Primate: Implications for Anthropoid Origins.
title.zh: Maiolino 等（2012）：北美适应猴类梳理爪的证据及其对拟人猿类起源的意义。

scope.en: Ray-specific comparisons of the named Notharctus foot material AMNH 143612/143640; functional interpretation, not observed grooming.
scope.zh: 针对具名 Notharctus 足部标本 AMNH 143612/143640 的分趾比较；结论属于功能解释，不是梳理行为观察。

readerLimitations.en: This page follows one semi-articulated foot sample and a proposed grooming-claw function. The fossil does not record grooming behaviour or frequency, variation across the population, or a direct role in anthropoid ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页介绍一组半关节连接的足部标本及其梳理爪解释。化石不能证明实际梳理行为及其频率、种群变异，也不能确定该足部在拟人猿祖先关系中的直接作用。

overviewZh: 来自怀俄明州 Bridger B 层的半关节相连足部 AMNH 143612/143640 保存了可分别归属到各趾的趾骨。研究者比较这些骨骼后，推断 *Notharctus* 第二趾具有理毛爪。其功能是根据解剖特征推断的；没有观察到实际理毛行为。这个 50–48.5 Ma 的地点样本无法确定该属的完整分布范围、直接祖先关系，或其是否属于现生灵长类冠群。
evidenceSummaryZh: 这件具名足部标本保存了可按趾比较的趾骨。第二趾上可能存在梳理爪属于功能性解释，并非观察到梳理行为，也不能据此认为所有 *Notharctus* 都有这种特征。
traitsZh: AMNH 143612 和 AMNH 143640 代表的半关节连接足部。
归属于不同趾位的趾骨。
推断第二趾具有理毛爪功能。

commonNameZh: 中始新世曙猿孤立跗骨样本
overview: Researchers attributed isolated calcanei (heel bones) and tali (ankle bones) from Shanghuang fissure fillings and the Yuanqu Basin in China to *Eosimias*. They scored ankle features in a comparative matrix and recovered anthropoid affinity, but the bones are not associated with teeth, so both their taxonomic link and tree position are inferences. The broad 45–40.5 Ma interval describes these locality samples, not the full range of the genus.

ecology.diet: The ankle bones do not record diet.
ecology.habitat: Fissure-fill and basin deposits locate the finds; neither establishes habitual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Ankle shape allows comparison, but the fossils do not show observed movement or a complete gait.
ecology.bodySize: Body-size estimates from isolated ankle bones are comparative, not a population estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled ankle bones do not identify an ecological role.
ecology.habitatZh: 裂隙充填沉积和盆地沉积标明了化石发现地点；两者都不能确定其惯常栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 踝骨形态可用于比较，但化石未显示可直接观察的运动或完整步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 根据孤立踝骨估算的体型用于比较，并非种群体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 取样的踝骨不能确定其生态作用。

traits: Isolated heel and ankle bones (calcanei and tali)
Separate locality samples from Shanghuang and Yuanqu
A mix of ankle features assessed in an anthropoid-affinity analysis
evidenceSummary: The study reports isolated heel and ankle bones from Shanghuang and Yuanqu and tests their attribution with selected anatomical characters. They are not associated with teeth or a complete foot. The 45–40.5 Ma envelope is broad locality context, not a genus-wide range; placement near anthropoids depends on the comparative matrix.

title.en: Ankle bones from two Chinese localities
title.zh: 中国两个地点的踝骨样本

text.en: The study describes isolated calcanei and tali from fissure fillings at Shanghuang and from the Yuanqu Basin in China. These are pieces of the ankle, not a complete foot attached to a skull or teeth. Researchers attributed them to *Eosimias* by comparing their shape with known anatomy, so the two localities and the isolated bones matter when interpreting the result.
text.zh: 研究描述了来自中国 Shanghuang 裂隙充填物和垣曲盆地的孤立跟骨与距骨。这些骨骼只是踝部的一部分，不是与头骨或牙齿相连的完整足部。研究者通过比较已知解剖形态，将其归入 *Eosimias*；理解结论时应保留标本孤立、地点不同这两个条件。

title.en: Testing an anthropoid relationship
title.zh: 检验与类人猿的亲缘关系

text.en: The authors scored ankle features in a comparative matrix to test whether the fossils support an anthropoid relationship. The bones preserve a mixture of characters, and their placement depends on which features and fossil comparisons enter the analysis. Anthropoid affinity is therefore a result of this comparison, not a label directly visible on one bone.
text.zh: 作者将踝部特征录入比较矩阵，检验化石是否支持类人猿亲缘。骨骼保存的是一组组合特征，其位置取决于纳入比较的性状和化石。因此，类人猿亲缘是这项比较分析的结果，不是单块骨头上直接可见的分类标签。

title.en: What the ankle bones cannot show
title.zh: 踝骨不能显示什么

text.en: The tarsals are not associated with the teeth used to define *Eosimias*. They do not reveal the animal's full range of movement, diet or habitual habitat. Attributing the bones to the genus and placing that genus on a tree are separate inferences; neither makes these ankle bones a complete picture of the animal.
text.zh: 这些跗骨并未与用于界定 *Eosimias* 的牙齿化石关联，无法揭示动物完整的运动方式、食性或惯常栖地。把骨骼归入该属，与判断该属在演化树上的位置，是两个不同的推断步骤；这组踝骨不能代表整只动物。

title.en: Gebo et al. (2000). The oldest known anthropoid postcranial fossils and the early evolution of higher primates.
title.zh: Gebo 等（2000）：已知最早的拟人猿类附肢化石与高等灵长类早期演化。

scope.en: Isolated Shanghuang and Yuanqu tarsals and their comparative character-matrix test; not a dentally associated skeleton.
scope.zh: Shanghuang 与垣曲孤立跗骨及其比较特征矩阵检验；没有与牙齿相连的骨架。

readerLimitations.en: This page describes isolated ankle bones and how researchers compared them with other fossils. Because they are not associated with teeth or a complete foot, they cannot establish the animal's full anatomy, habitual movement, ecology or direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页介绍的是孤立踝骨及其比较归属。由于没有与牙齿或完整足部关联，这些化石不能确立动物的完整解剖、惯常运动方式、生态或直接祖先关系。

overviewZh: 研究者将来自中国商黄裂隙充填物和垣曲盆地的孤立跟骨（后跟骨）及距骨（踝骨）归属到 *Eosimias*。他们在比较矩阵中评估踝部特征，结果显示其与类人猿支系有亲缘关系；但这些骨骼没有与牙齿关联，因此其分类归属和系统树位置都属于推断。45–40.5 Ma 的宽泛时段描述的是这些产地样本，并非该属的完整年代范围。
evidenceSummaryZh: 该研究报道了来自 Shanghuang 和 Yuanqu 的孤立跟骨与踝部骨骼，并用选定的解剖特征检验其归属。它们并未与牙齿或完整足部关联。45–40.5 Ma 时间范围是宽泛的地点背景，并非整个属的分布时段；其接近高等灵长类的位置取决于比较矩阵。
traitsZh: 来自 Shanghuang 和 Yuanqu 的不同地点样本。
在类人猿亲缘关系分析中评估的一组踝部特征。

overview: COL26.8 usage 4C92G is the accepted species record. The biological examples here come from separate studies; habitat-use evidence is bounded to one wild community at Bossou.

ecology.diet: The Bossou study records feeding locations, not a species-wide diet.
ecology.habitat: Mature forest was the most selected habitat overall in the sampled Bossou community. This is a site-level result.
ecology.locomotion: The selected habitat-use study did not assess locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: The selected habitat-use study did not assess body size.
ecology.guild: A one-site habitat-use study does not establish a species-wide ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: Bossou 研究记录了取食地点，但没有综合整个物种的食谱。
ecology.habitatZh: 在 Bossou 受研究群体中，整体上选择成熟林的比例最高。这是一个地点的结果。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所选栖地利用研究没有评估运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所选栖地利用研究没有评估体型。
ecology.guildZh: 单一地点的栖地利用研究不能确定整个物种的生态功能群。

evidenceSummary: Researchers followed one wild community at Bossou daily for a year, including 10 adult focal individuals. These observations do not establish species-wide habitat use or a current range-wide synthesis.

context.en: Continue with another featured primate introduction.
context.zh: 继续阅读另一篇精选灵长类物种介绍。

title.en: Different studies answer different questions
title.zh: 不同研究回答不同问题

text.zh: 贡贝的雌性生命史记录、Bossou 的取食观察，以及不同照护环境下的体重比较，分别研究黑猩猩生活的不同方面。每项研究都有各自的种群和样本；合在一起也不能定义每只黑猩猩都遵循的固定模式。
text.en: Female life-history records at Gombe, feeding observations at Bossou and body-mass comparisons across care settings examine different aspects of chimpanzee lives. Each has its own population and sample; together they do not define one fixed pattern for every chimpanzee.

title.en: A range account with a date
title.zh: 带有时间标记的分布记录

text.en: The 2016 IUCN assessment described a discontinuous range of more than 2.6 million km², from southern Senegal across the forest belt north of the Congo River to western Tanzania and western Uganda. It described four subspecies ranges. This dated account is not a current range map.
text.zh: IUCN 2016 年评估记载，黑猩猩分布区不连续，面积超过 260 万平方公里，从塞内加尔南部沿刚果河以北的森林带延伸至坦桑尼亚西部和乌干达西部，并分别描述四个亚种的分布。这是一份有年代的记载，不是当前分布图。

title.en: What one forest-edge study found
title.zh: 一项森林边缘研究的发现

text.en: At Bossou, Guinea, researchers followed one wild western chimpanzee community for up to six hours a day from April 2012 to March 2013; the focal sample included 10 adults. Mature forest was the most selected habitat overall. Among feeding events in uncultivated habitat, records more than 200 m from fields exceeded chance expectations, while the 0–200 m bands fell below them. The authors suggested field-associated risks may shape feeding locations. This is a local result, not a species-wide habitat rule.
text.zh: 在几内亚 Bossou，研究者于 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月跟踪一个野生西部黑猩猩群体，每天至多观察 6 小时；焦点样本包括 10 只成年个体。总体上，成熟林是选择比例最高的栖地。在非耕地栖地的取食事件中，距耕地超过 200 米的记录高于随机预期，0–200 米范围内的记录则低于预期。作者提出耕地相关风险可能影响取食地点；这是当地结果，不是全物种的栖地规律。

title.en: Stick use in one foraging task
title.zh: 特定取食任务中的棍棒使用

text.en: At Taï National Park in Côte d’Ivoire, a cross-sectional video study recorded 1,460 stick-use events from 70 wild western chimpanzees in three neighboring communities. In a model of grips used to insert sticks, the multi-digit grip became predominant at about 5.2 years, with a 98% predicted probability of use by age 15. Only three females from one community contributed observations above 45 years. This pattern describes the task and sample studied; it is not a universal developmental curve or proof of a cognitive cause.
text.zh: 在科特迪瓦 Taï 国家公园，横断面视频研究记录了三个相邻野生西部黑猩猩群体中 70 只个体的 1,460 次棍棒使用事件。针对插入棍棒时所用握法的模型估计，多指握法约在 5.2 岁成为主导，到 15 岁时预测使用概率为 98%。45 岁以上的观察仅来自一个群体的 3 只雌性。这一模式只描述所研究的任务和样本，不能当作普遍发育曲线，也不能证明认知成因。

title.en: Maturity and first births at Gombe
title.zh: 贡贝种群的性成熟与首次生育

text.en: Long-term records at Gombe National Park in western Tanzania covered 36 known-age wild females. Their mean age at sexual maturity was 11.5 years and mean age at first birth was 14.9 years. First-birth estimates came from a smaller, censored subset in which non-dispersing females were overrepresented, so they may be biased low. These are estimates for one population, not fixed values for every chimpanzee.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝国家公园的长期记录纳入 36 只已知年龄的野生雌性黑猩猩。其性成熟平均年龄为 11.5 岁，首次生育平均年龄为 14.9 岁。首次生育估计来自更小且包含删失记录的子样本，其中未迁出的雌性比例偏高，因此估计值可能偏低。这些是一个种群的估计，不是每只黑猩猩都遵循的固定数值。

title.en: Body mass across care settings
title.zh: 不同照护环境中的体重比较

text.en: A study compared 298 chimpanzees in African sanctuaries, 1,030 in zoos and 442 in research facilities. After age adjustment, adults in zoos and research facilities had greater body mass than sanctuary animals in both sexes; estimated growth was slower in the sanctuary cohort. The groups included mixed or unknown subspecies and different care settings, so the comparison cannot stand in for wild morphology or a subspecies comparison.
text.zh: 一项研究比较了非洲救护中心的 298 只黑猩猩、动物园的 1,030 只和研究机构的 442 只。校正年龄后，动物园和研究机构的成年个体在雌雄中体重都高于救护中心个体；救护中心队列的估计生长速度较慢。各组包含不同或未知亚种，照护环境也不同，因此该比较不能代表野生形态或亚种间差异。

title.en: A model of population history
title.zh: 关于种群历史的模型

text.en: A whole-genome site-pattern study sampled four chimpanzee lineages—central, eastern, Nigeria–Cameroon and western—alongside bonobos. Its best-fitting model estimated gene flow from western into eastern chimpanzees and placed the shared ancestor of the four sampled chimpanzee lineages at about 987,000 years ago. These are model-based population-history estimates; the authors discuss competing histories, and the estimates are not fossil dates.
text.zh: 一项全基因组位点模式研究在倭黑猩猩之外，还采样了中部、东部、尼日利亚—喀麦隆和西部四个黑猩猩谱系。拟合最佳的模型估计西部向东部黑猩猩发生过基因流动，并将四个受采样谱系的共同祖先时间估为约 987,000 年前。这些是种群史模型估计；作者讨论了其他可能历史，它们不是化石定年结果。

title.en: A regional conservation estimate
title.zh: 一项区域保育估计

text.en: A spatial model estimated 128,760 weaned central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa in 2013 (95% CI 114,208–317,039); it estimated that 80.7% of this subspecies in the modeled region was outside the protected-area network. The result concerns one subspecies and a historical model period. The cited IUCN assessment is version 2016-2, with errata published in 2018; its Endangered category is not presented here as a verified current status.
text.zh: 一项空间模型估算，2013 年西赤道非洲的中部黑猩猩亚种有 128,760 只已断奶个体（95% 置信区间：114,208–317,039）；模型还估计该区域内 80.7% 的这一亚种个体位于保护区网络之外。结果只针对一个亚种和历史模型时期。所引 IUCN 评估为 2016-2 版，2018 年发布勘误；这里不把其中的“濒危”类别表述为经核实的当前状态。

title.en: Humle et al. (2016). Pan troglodytes. The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species, version 2016-2.
title.zh: Humle 等（2016）：Pan troglodytes，《IUCN 受威胁物种红色名录》2016-2 版。

scope.en: Dated species-level assessment with a 2016 range account and status; errata were published in 2018. It is not verified here as the current Red List assessment.
scope.zh: 有年代的物种级评估，分布记述与状态来自 2016 版，2018 年发布勘误；此处未将其核实为当前红色名录评估。

title.en: Bryson-Morrison et al. (2017). Activity and habitat use at Bossou, Guinea.
title.zh: Bryson-Morrison 等（2017）：几内亚 Bossou 的活动与栖地利用研究。

scope.en: One wild P. t. verus community at Bossou, followed from April 2012 to March 2013; 10 adult focal individuals.
scope.zh: 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月在 Bossou 跟踪一个野生 P. t. verus 群体，焦点样本为 10 只成年个体。

title.en: Malherbe et al. (2024). Protracted development of stick tool use skills in wild western chimpanzees.
title.zh: Malherbe 等（2024）：野生西部黑猩猩棍棒工具使用技能的延长发育。

scope.en: Cross-sectional video study of three neighboring Taï communities, November 2013–April 2020; stick-based extractive-foraging tasks.
scope.zh: 2013 年 11 月至 2020 年 4 月对 Taï 三个相邻群体开展的横断面视频研究，观察棍棒取食任务。

title.en: Walker et al. (2018). Maturation is prolonged and variable in female chimpanzees.
title.zh: Walker 等（2018）：雌性黑猩猩的成熟期延长且存在差异。

scope.en: Long-term life-history records for known-age wild females at Gombe, western Tanzania; 36 females in the maturation analysis.
scope.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝的野生雌性长期生活史记录；成熟分析纳入 36 只已知年龄个体。

title.en: Curry et al. (2023). Body mass and growth rates in captive chimpanzees across care settings.
title.zh: Curry 等（2023）：不同照护环境下圈养黑猩猩的体重与生长速度。

scope.en: Comparison of sanctuary, zoo and research cohorts with mixed or unavailable subspecies; not a wild body-size estimate.
scope.zh: 比较救护中心、动物园与研究机构队列；亚种混合或未知，不是野生体型估计。

title.en: Brand et al. (2022). Estimating bonobo and chimpanzee evolutionary history from nucleotide site patterns.
title.zh: Brand 等（2022）：从核苷酸位点模式估计倭黑猩猩与黑猩猩的演化史。

scope.en: Whole-genome site-pattern analysis across the five extant Pan lineages; history and dates are model estimates.

Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico (managed free-ranging morphology study population)

ecology.diet: At Buxa, fruit accounted for 70.8% of recorded diet in the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% in the October–April provisioning period for one 64-individual troop.
ecology.habitat: The selected Buxa troop home range included patches of natural forest, mixed-species plantations and residential settlements; this is one local study setting, not a full habitat account.

traits: In one 2015 Cayo Santiago pedigree sample, most measured male morphometric traits were heritable under the study’s pooled models; this cohort result is not species-wide.
evidenceSummary: Selected evidence spans Chinese population genomics, one Buxa troop, managed Cayo Santiago cohorts and one NH-7 road segment. The 54 road deaths recorded in 2009–2010 are a local count, not a population mortality estimate or current conservation assessment.

title.en: Body, life and relationships
title.zh: 从体形到取食，群体之间有哪些差异？

text.zh: 恒河猴的体形、取食和繁殖，并不能由一个群体的记录全部概括。圣地亚哥岛有谱系记录的猴群提供了体重、头臀长和犬齿的测量；印度野生群体的跟踪则记录了食物与活动距离的季节变化。中国样本中的遗传谱系呈现另一种群体差异。把这些材料放在一起阅读，首先要分清每项研究观察了哪些猴群。
text.en: Body mass, crown–rump length and canine length can be measured in one pedigreed rhesus-macaque population; seasonal feeding and daily travel require follows of another wild troop. Genetic lineages in Chinese samples address relationships at a different scale. The differences between sites and samples are part of the findings.

title.en: One species, several study populations
title.zh: 同一个名称，几处不同的生活环境

text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca mulatta. The studies brought together here sampled wild macaques in China and India, plus managed free-ranging groups at Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico. These settings answer different questions and should not be combined into one range-wide ecological portrait.
text.zh: 这里的恒河猴对应固定版本 COL26.8 接受的名称 Macaca mulatta。所选材料来自中国和印度的野生猴群，也来自波多黎各圣地亚哥岛受管理的自由活动群体。野生观察与受管理群体的研究各有自己的问题和样本；这些地点不能拼成覆盖整个物种分布区的生活画像。

title.en: Genetic lineages in Chinese samples
title.zh: 中国样本中的遗传谱系

text.en: A population-genomic study sampled 81 wild rhesus macaques at 17 sites across China, representing five subspecies. The analysis identified five genetic lineages and reported evidence of recent gene flow. These results describe the sampled Chinese populations and the study’s models, not a complete global species tree or range map.
text.zh: 中国 17 个地点的 81 只野生恒河猴，为一项群体基因组研究提供了样本，涵盖五个亚种。分析识别出五个遗传谱系，同时报告了近期基因流动的证据。这里的关系图反映的是被采样的中国种群以及论文采用的分析模型，不能当作全球恒河猴的完整谱系或分布图。

title.en: Seasonal feeding at Buxa
title.zh: 食物比例与活动距离一起变化

text.en: Researchers followed one 64-member troop near Buxa Tiger Reserve from October 2013 to September 2014. Fruit made up 70.8% of recorded diet during the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% during the October–April provisioning period. Mean daily travel was 4.72 km and 2.58 km respectively; the comparison does not separate every seasonal influence.
text.zh: 布克萨虎保护区附近，一个由 64 只恒河猴组成的群体在 2013 年 10 月至 2014 年 9 月受到跟踪。按论文划分，5–9 月是非投喂期，记录饮食中的水果比例为 70.8%，平均日活动距离为 4.72 公里；10–4 月投喂期的相应数值为 28.8% 和 2.58 公里。食物比例与活动距离在两期之间都有差异，但这个比较没有排除所有季节因素，不能单凭它把差异归因于投喂。

title.en: What a Cayo Santiago pedigree measured
title.zh: 体形测量怎样与家族谱系联系起来

text.en: A 2015 Cayo Santiago sample measured 125 adult males and 21 female relatives. Under the study’s pooled pedigree models, several male traits—including body mass, crown–rump length and canine length—met the authors’ heritability criterion; testicular volume did not, and its estimate was imprecise. This managed population is not a morphology survey of macaques throughout their native range.
text.zh: 2015 年的圣地亚哥岛研究测量了 125 只成年雄性和 21 只雌性亲属，并把身体测量与谱系记录放入同一模型。体重、头臀长和犬齿长等若干雄性特征达到作者设定的遗传率标准；睾丸体积没有达到，估计区间也较宽。各特征的结果因此需要分别理解。这是一个受管理群体的研究，并非恒河猴原生分布区的整体形态调查。

title.en: Mating-season records at Cayo Santiago
title.zh: 一个交配季能说明多少繁殖差异

text.en: During the 2013 mating season, a study followed 21 high-ranking males aged 7–21 years across nine provisioned, semi-free-ranging groups. Older males were associated with fewer offspring recorded by the study. Paternity was sampled when offspring reached one year, so infants that died earlier were not assigned to sires; the result is not lifetime reproductive success.
text.zh: 2013 年交配季，一项研究跟踪了九个补饲、半自由活动群体中的 21 只高等级雄性，年龄为 7–21 岁。在这组记录里，年龄较大的雄性对应较少后代。这个结果还有一个关键的取样边界：亲子鉴定在幼体满一岁时进行，此前死亡的幼体没有归属父亲。因此，它描述的是该研究记录到的后代差异，不能表示雄性一生的繁殖成功率。

title.en: Road deaths on one Indian highway
title.zh: 公路记录里的 54 只恒河猴

text.en: From August 2009 to July 2010, observers recorded 54 rhesus macaques killed along an 11-km section of National Highway 7 near Pench: 27 in summer, 19 in winter and eight in the monsoon. Associations with traffic and roadside feeding are local observations, not a population mortality rate or a current threat assessment.
text.zh: 在潘奇附近国家公路 7 号的一段 11 公里路段，观察者于 2009 年 8 月至 2010 年 7 月记录到 54 只恒河猴死亡。其中夏季为 27 只、冬季为 19 只、季风期为 8 只。论文讨论了这些记录与车流、路边投喂的关联；这里呈现的是这段公路的局地观察，不能用这些数量计算整个种群的死亡率，也不能替代当前受威胁评估。

geography: Lake Manyara National Park, Tanzania (wild road-transect study, 2011–2019)
Gombe National Park, Tanzania (wild reproductive records, 1972–2002)

overview: The selected Papio anubis studies follow a captive growth cohort, long-term wild pregnancy records, a Lake Manyara survey-method comparison and a small comparative-genomic sample. Each answers a different question; together they are not a species-wide account.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected core studies.
ecology.habitat: The Lake Manyara paper compares road-transect estimates with a sleeping-site-based upper limit; roads are a possible source of sampling bias, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core studies.

ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core studies.

title.en: Body, life and relationships
title.zh: 身体、生活与关系

text.zh: 橄榄狒狒从幼年到成年的体型变化，曾在一个圈养队列中连续跟踪七年。野外的妊娠记录和夜宿点调查则提供了另外两种观察窗口：前者研究繁殖关联，后者让研究者发现道路调查可能高估密度。不同材料描述的是生活的不同侧面。
text.en: Growth from infancy to adulthood was followed for seven years in one captive olive-baboon cohort. Wild pregnancy records and sleeping-site surveys offer two other windows: reproductive associations and evidence that road transects can overestimate density. Different material describes different parts of life.

title.en: A name does not supply its range
title.zh: 名称本身不能说明分布范围

text.en: COL26.8 accepts the name Papio anubis. The studies here come from a captive station in France, long-term wild records at Gombe, a survey-method study at Lake Manyara and a comparative genomic sample. They illuminate different questions and do not describe every population.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受 Papio anubis 这个名称。这里的研究分别来自法国圈养研究站、贡贝长期野外记录、曼雅拉湖调查方法研究和比较基因组样本。它们回答不同问题，并不代表所有种群。

title.en: Growth from infancy in a captive cohort
title.zh: 圈养队列从幼年到成年的生长

text.en: A seven-year longitudinal study at the CNRS primatology station followed 14 females and 16 males from at least two months of age to adulthood. Measured size and shape were similar at birth; later differences in growth rate and duration produced substantial size differences while the measured body-shape pattern remained similar. This is a captive cohort, not a wild growth curve.
text.zh: 法国国家科学研究中心灵长类研究站的一项七年纵向研究，跟踪了 14 只雌性和 16 只雄性，从至少两月龄观察到成年。出生时测量的体型和形状相近；之后生长速度和持续时间不同，形成明显体型差异，而测量到的身体形状模式仍相近。这是圈养队列，不是野外生长曲线。

title.en: Miscarriage records at Gombe
title.zh: 贡贝的流产记录

text.en: Gombe records from 1972–2002 covered 732 pregnancies among 175 females of known rank; 65 pregnancies ended in miscarriage. The study found that rank-related patterns varied with rainfall and the immigration of males that rose rapidly to the highest rank. When mean rainfall over two years fell below about 1,100 mm, the rank-linked pattern largely disappeared. These observational associations are not a species-wide miscarriage rate or proof of cause.
text.zh: 贡贝 1972–2002 年记录涵盖 175 只已知等级雌性的 732 次妊娠，其中 65 次以流产告终。研究发现，等级相关模式会随降雨和快速升至最高等级的移入雄性而变化；当两年平均降雨低于约 1,100 毫米时，等级关联模式大体消失。这些观察性关联不是全物种流产率，也不能证明因果。

title.en: Why road surveys can overestimate density
title.zh: 为什么道路调查可能高估密度

text.en: At Lake Manyara, Tanzania, road-transect surveys from 2011–2019 produced density estimates more than three times an upper limit derived from sleeping-site counts and average group size. The authors pointed to baboons’ use of roads as a possible source of bias. This is a warning about one survey method at one site, not an estimate of the park’s total population or its trend.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚曼雅拉湖 2011–2019 年道路样线调查得出的密度估计，超过根据夜宿点计数和平均群体大小推算上限的三倍。作者指出狒狒使用道路可能造成偏差。这是对一个地点一种调查方法的警示，不是公园总种群或其变化趋势的估计。

title.en: A 12-animal comparative genomic panel
title.zh: 由 12 只个体组成的比较基因组面板

text.en: A Papio phylogeny study sampled two animals from each of six extant baboon species, 12 individuals in total. Within that panel, the authors identified 4,645 Alu insertion sites as P. anubis indicator loci under their method. This result describes a comparative sample and a particular marker system; it does not summarize genetic variation within the species or settle its complete evolutionary history.
text.zh: 一项 Papio 系统发育研究按其设计为六个现生狒狒种各采样两只，共 12 只个体。在这一面板中，作者按其方法将 4,645 个 Alu 插入位点识别为 P. anubis 指示位点。结果描述的是特定比较样本和标记系统，不能概括该物种内部的遗传变异，也不能定论其完整演化史。

title.en: What these studies leave open
title.zh: 这些研究仍留下哪些问题

text.en: The studies do not establish a full current distribution, formal conservation status, a species-wide wild diet or locomotion synthesis, or a complete fossil and evolutionary history. Those questions require evidence beyond the selected samples.
text.zh: 这些研究没有确定完整的现今分布、正式保育状态、全物种野外饮食或运动综合，也没有提供完整化石记录和演化史。回答这些问题需要超出所选样本范围的证据。

overview: COL26.8 lists Macaca radiata as a species. The evidence here brings together local surveys in southern India, a museum comparison among macaque species and a mitochondrial DNA study. These samples answer different questions; they do not map the current range or establish a species-wide population trend.

evidenceSummary: Selected evidence includes a 2017 southern India survey and a 2018 comparison of 711 specimens from 12 macaque species, including 79 bonnet macaques. That cross-species sample does not establish diagnostic variation within Macaca radiata. A separate 2018 study analyzed 82 fecal-derived mitochondrial D-loop sequences from 16 southern Indian locations; one mitochondrial marker does not establish nuclear or genome-wide structure, and the proposed human-mediated translocation explanation remains a hypothesis. These studies do not settle life history, full range or current formal conservation status.

title.en: Body, life and relationships
title.zh: 身体、生活与关系

text.zh: 博物馆中的颅牙标本与印度南部的森林、道路和寺庙记录，提供了认识冠猕猴的不同材料。标本比较针对猕猴属的种间差异，地方调查则研究规定区域内的出现与计数变化。两者需要各自的范围，才能避免把局地结果当成整个物种的规律。
text.en: Museum craniodental specimens and forest, road and temple records in southern India offer different material for bonnet macaques. The specimens support an interspecific macaque comparison; local surveys examine occurrences and counts within defined areas. Each needs its own scope before a result can be generalized.

title.en: Local records, not a range-wide census
title.zh: 地方记录不是全分布区普查

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca radiata. The evidence summarized here comes from selected southern Indian forests, roads and human-use sites, plus museum specimens used in a comparison across macaque species. It does not provide a current map or a complete population trend.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Macaca radiata。本文概述的证据来自印度南部若干森林、道路和人类活动地点，另有用于猕猴属种间比较的博物馆标本。这些材料没有给出当前分布图或完整种群趋势。

title.en: A forest occupancy estimate at Parambikulam
title.zh: Parambikulam 的森林占域估计

text.en: In one survey of the Parambikulam landscape in Kerala, observers detected 54 groups in 33 of 64 grid cells. The fitted mean occupancy estimate was 0.51 ± 0.08 (SE), where occupancy is the modelled share of sampled cells used by macaques; detection probability was 0.25 ± 0.05. These estimates belong to that forest survey and its sampling design.
text.zh: 喀拉拉邦 Parambikulam 景观的一次调查中，研究者在 64 个网格中的 33 个记录到 54 个群体。模型估计平均占域率为 0.51 ± 0.08（标准误）；占域率指模型估算的已使用网格比例，检测概率为 0.25 ± 0.05。这些估计只适用于该次森林调查及其抽样设计。

title.en: Roadside counts connected to Mysore
title.zh: 连接迈索尔的路边计数

text.en: The study’s roadside counts fell from 889 in 2003 to 407 in 2015 on roads connected to Mysore. The 2015 resurvey covered 464 km and used a 15-m strip on each side of the road centreline. A roadside count measures animals visible within a defined survey band; the change is not a census of the species across southern India.
text.zh: 该研究在连接迈索尔的道路上记录的路边数量，从 2003 年的 889 只降至 2015 年的 407 只。2015 年复查覆盖 464 公里，调查带为道路中心线两侧各 15 米。路边计数反映的是规定调查带内可见的个体变化，不是对印度南部全物种的普查。

title.en: Temple and tourist-site histories
title.zh: 寺庙与旅游地点的历史记录

text.en: The same paper compared selected southern Indian temple and tourist locations over historical records and follow-up surveys from 2009–2015. About 31% of assessed locations recorded bonnet macaques; among reported translocation cases, roughly one fifth were followed by reappearance, while more than 48% were recorded as disappearance or removal. These site histories do not describe present-day occupancy across the full range.
text.zh: 同一论文比较了印度南部部分寺庙和旅游地点的历史记录及 2009–2015 年复查。约 31% 的受评地点记录到冠猕猴；在报告的迁移案例中，约五分之一随后有重新出现记录，超过 48% 被记录为消失或清除。这些地点史不能代表当前全分布区的占域情况。

title.en: Bonnet macaques in a museum comparison
title.zh: 种间博物馆比较中的冠猕猴标本

text.en: A 2018 comparison covered 711 museum specimens from 12 macaque species, including 79 M. radiata specimens (46 male and 33 female) attributed to southern and western India; subadults were also included. The paper reported a weak interspecific latitudinal pattern. Its mixed specimen origins and cross-species design do not establish diagnostic traits or variation within bonnet macaques.
text.zh: 一项 2018 年比较研究纳入 12 种猕猴的 711 件博物馆标本，其中 79 件冠猕猴标本（雄性 46 件、雌性 33 件）标注来自印度南部和西部，也包括亚成体。论文报告了较弱的种间纬度模式。标本来源不一且研究设计针对种间比较，不能据此确定冠猕猴的诊断性状或种内变异。

title.en: What these studies leave open
title.zh: 这些研究仍未回答什么

text.en: The selected sources do not synthesize the species’ life history, diet, locomotion, full distribution or current formal conservation category. A local recommendation in the 2017 article is not a statutory designation or an independently verified current status.
text.zh: 所选来源尚未综合该物种的生活史、饮食、运动方式、完整分布或当前正式保育类别。2017 年论文提出的地方性建议不是法定指定，也不是独立核实的当前状态。

title.en: Catalogue of Life COL26.8, usage 3WWP2
title.zh: Catalogue of Life COL26.8，usage 3WWP2

scope.en: Pinned accepted-name record only; not evidence for current distribution or status.
scope.zh: 仅为固定版本接受名记录，不作为当前分布或保育状态的证据。

title.en: Erinjery et al. (2017), roadside, forest and human-use sites in southern India
title.zh: Erinjery 等（2017）：印度南部道路、森林与人类活动地点

scope.en: Bounded local surveys and historical site comparisons; not a species-wide current census.
scope.zh: 范围有限的地方调查与历史地点比较，不是全物种当前普查。

title.en: Grunstra et al. (2018), macaque craniodental variation
title.zh: Grunstra 等（2018）：猕猴属颅齿变异比较

scope.en: Interspecific comparison of 711 museum specimens across 12 species; 79 were M. radiata.
scope.zh: 12 种猕猴 711 件博物馆标本的种间比较；其中 79 件为 M. radiata。

context.zh: 对照另一篇猕猴属物种页。
对照另一篇猕猴属物种页。

readerLimitations.en: The selected studies do not establish a current range-wide population trend, a complete life history, species-wide ecology or present formal conservation status. Local survey results remain tied to their places and methods.
readerLimitations.zh: 所选研究尚不能确定全分布区的当前种群趋势、完整生活史、物种层面的整体生态或现行正式保育状态。各项地方调查结果仍受其地点与方法限制。

geography: Western Ghats, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, India (15 named sampling sites, 2010–2012; wild fecal samples)
Puthuthottam forest fragment, Valparai plateau, Tamil Nadu, India (one troop; February–May 2016 study site)
overview: COL26.8 accepts Macaca silenus (Linnaeus, 1758). The ecological observations below come from specific groups, places and periods, while genetic studies use mitochondrial samples; these records do not form a complete range-wide account.

ecology.diet: At Puthuthottam, one troop ate plant parts from 19 species and other foods during a 2016 dry-season study. Plant feeding was greater in forest interior than at the edge; invertebrate feeding was greater in an open patch than in the interior.
ecology.habitat: Over 480 follow-hours in one habituated troop covered forest interior, edge, an open patch and a settlement from February to May 2016. Active foraging was higher in the open patch and edge, and lower in the settlement than in the interior.
ecology.locomotion: The selected studies did not examine locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: The selected studies do not provide comparative body-size measurements.
ecology.guild: These local observations do not establish a species-wide ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 在 2016 年旱季研究中，Puthuthottam 的一群个体取食了 19 种植物的不同部位及其他食物。林内的植物取食多于林缘；而开阔斑块中的无脊椎动物取食多于林内。
ecology.habitatZh: 2016 年 2 月至 5 月，对一个已习惯人类观察的猴群进行了超过 480 小时的跟踪观察，覆盖森林内部、林缘、开阔地块和聚居地。开阔地块与林缘的主动觅食较多，聚居地则少于森林内部。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所选研究没有考察运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所选研究没有提供可比较的体型测量数据。
ecology.guildZh: 这些局部观察无法确定整个物种共有的生态类群。

evidenceSummary: Local feeding and activity observations cover one troop in one dry season. Genetic samples, a separate four-group seed-dispersal preprint and the checklist answer different questions; together they do not provide a range-wide or annual ecological synthesis.

title.en: How field observations and genetic samples answer different questions
title.zh: 野外观察与遗传样本分别回答什么问题

text.zh: Puthuthottam 研究中的森林内部、林缘和开阔斑块提供了不同取食环境。一项研究在旱季跟踪一个猴群，遗传研究则比较西高止山脉各地的线粒体样本。这些记录描述地方行为和受采样谱系，并非该物种的完整综述。
text.en: Forest interiors, edges and open patches provide different feeding settings in the Puthuthottam study. One troop was followed during the dry season, while genetic studies compared mitochondrial samples from Western Ghats sites. These records describe local behaviour and sampled lineages, not a complete account of the species.

title.en: Sampling across the Western Ghats
title.zh: 西高止山脉的采样

text.en: A 2010–2012 genetic study sampled wild animals at 15 sites in Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, and included separately identified captive blood samples. These are study locations, not the full present-day range.
text.zh: 一项 2010—2012 年遗传研究在卡纳塔克邦、喀拉拉邦和泰米尔纳德邦的 15 个地点采集野生样本，另行分析了明确标注的圈养血液样本。这些是研究采样地点，不是完整的现今分布图。

title.en: Activity in a forest-fragment landscape
title.zh: 森林碎片景观中的活动

text.en: From February to May 2016, researchers followed one habituated troop at Puthuthottam for more than 480 hours across forest interior, edge, an open patch and a settlement. Active foraging was higher in the open patch and at the edge, and lower in the settlement than in the interior. The comparison concerns one troop in one dry season.
text.zh: 2016 年 2 月至 5 月，研究者在 Puthuthottam 跟踪一个习惯观察者的猴群，累计超过 480 小时，地点包括林内、林缘、开阔斑块和聚居地。开阔斑块与林缘的主动觅食较多；聚居地低于林内。这项比较仅涉及一个猴群和一个旱季。

title.en: Foods recorded in that troop
title.zh: 该猴群记录到的食物

text.en: The troop ate parts from 19 plant species as well as non-plant foods. In the habitat comparisons, invertebrate feeding was more frequent in the open patch than in forest interior, while plant feeding was greater in the interior than at the edge. This is not a complete species diet.
text.zh: 猴群取食了 19 种植物的不同部分，也摄食非植物食物。按栖地比较，无脊椎动物取食在开阔斑块多于林内；植物取食在林内多于林缘。这不是该物种的完整食谱。

title.en: A four-group seed-dispersal preprint
title.zh: 四个群体的种子传播预印本

text.en: A version-one 2024 bioRxiv preprint reports 375.9 hours of focal observations across four groups in a 92-hectare Puduthottam fragment. Subadults consumed a greater variety of native and non-native fruits than adults, and dispersed fewer Ficus seeds than adult females. The sampling year is not reported; this result is from a preprint.
text.zh: 一篇 2024 年 bioRxiv 第一版预印本报告，在 Puduthottam 一处 92 公顷森林碎片中，对四个群体开展了 375.9 小时焦点观察。亚成体取食的本地与非本地水果种类多于成年个体，传播的 Ficus 种子少于成年雌性。研究未报告采样年份，结果仍属于预印本。

title.en: Mitochondrial lineages around the Palghat Gap
title.zh: Palghat 缺口两侧的线粒体谱系

text.en: A Western Ghats study distinguished sampled mitochondrial lineages north and south of the Palghat Gap. A fossil-calibrated model using 893 mitochondrial bases estimated their mean most-recent common ancestor at 2.11 million years ago. This is not a nuclear-genome species tree or a direct fossil date for the species’ origin.
text.zh: 一项西高止山脉研究识别了 Palghat 缺口南北受采样的线粒体谱系。基于 893 个线粒体碱基的化石校准模型，将其最近共同祖先的平均时间估为 211 万年前。这是标记有限的模型估计，不是核基因组物种树，也不是该物种起源的直接化石年代。

title.en: Genetic diversity in forest fragments
title.zh: 森林碎片中的遗传多样性

text.en: A separate study compared HVR-I mitochondrial samples from eight Anamalai forest fragments with nearby continuous-forest samples and found lower diversity in the fragments. It describes those samples and markers, not population viability or extinction risk.
text.zh: 另一项研究比较阿纳马莱八个森林碎片的 HVR-I 线粒体样本与邻近连续森林样本，发现碎片样本多样性较低。结果描述这些样本和标记，不能直接测量种群存续能力或预测灭绝风险。

title.en: What these studies do not measure
title.zh: 这些研究尚不能回答什么

text.en: The selected sources do not synthesize body size, life history, a complete range, annual ecology or current formal conservation status. Feeding observations come from one troop and season; the seed-dispersal results remain a preprint.
text.zh: 所选来源尚未综合体型、生活史、完整分布区、全年生态或当前正式保育状态。取食观察来自一个猴群和一个季节；种子传播结果仍来自预印本。

title.zh: Catalogue of Life COL26.8，usage 3WWP6

scope.zh: 仅为固定版本接受名记录，不作为完整分布或保育状态的证据。

title.en: Ram et al. (2015), genetic structure of lion-tailed macaques in the Western Ghats
title.zh: Ram 等（2015）：西高止山脉狮尾猕猴遗传结构

title.zh: Dhawale 等（2020）：Puthuthottam 的栖地与行为

scope.en: One habituated troop followed February–May 2016 across a local habitat matrix; not an annual or species-wide study.
scope.zh: 2016 年 2–5 月跟踪一个习惯化群体，调查当地栖地组合；不是全年或全物种研究。

title.en: Bindu et al. (2024), seed dispersal by age and sex (bioRxiv v1 preprint)

scope.zh: 一处 92 公顷森林碎片内的四个群体；未报告采样年份；第一版尚未经同行评审。

readerLimitations.en: The selected studies cover specific Western Ghats genetic samples and local observations, not a complete distribution, annual ecology, life history or current conservation assessment. Feeding observations come from one troop in one dry season; the seed-dispersal result is a preprint.
readerLimitations.zh: 所选研究覆盖西高止山脉的特定遗传样本和地方观察，不提供完整分布区、全年生态、生活史或当前保育评估。取食观察来自一个猴群的一个旱季；四群体种子传播结果来自预印本。

evidenceSummaryZh: 关于取食和活动的当地观察仅涵盖一个群体的一个旱季。遗传样本、另一项涵盖四个群体的种子传播预印本，以及名录回答的是不同问题；合在一起仍不足以形成覆盖全分布区或全年的生态综述。

geography: Brazil: northeastern coastal and inland records described by the selected study as native; southern records in São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais described as introductions. Presence-only study compilation, not exhaustive range limits.
overview: The pinned COL26.8 checklist records accepted usage 697NS as Callithrix jacchus (Linnaeus, 1758). The studies gathered here ask narrower questions: how adults’ coats compare, what Brazilian occurrence and rabies reports record, what one captive colony found about fathers and infants, and how sampled mitochondrial lineages relate. Together they are a set of evidence windows, not a complete account of the species.
overviewZh: COL26.8 清单将普通狨列为接受种 Callithrix jacchus（Linnaeus, 1758），并置于 Callithrix 属下。本页把成体外貌比较、巴西出现与狂犬病报告、一个圈养群体中的父亲回应研究，以及线粒体谱系估计并列呈现；它们分别回答局部问题，合起来仍不是完整的物种生活史或生态综述。

evidenceSummary: The evidence spans a captive-colony association between paternal responsiveness and infant outcomes, Brazil’s passive rabies reports, and a model-based mitochondrial-lineage estimate. None establishes wild life history or species-wide ecology, a complete distribution, a nuclear-genome divergence date or formal conservation status.

title.en: Body, life and relationships
title.zh: 身体、生活与关系

text.zh: 白色耳簇和额部浅色星斑，是普通狨成体外形描述中醒目的特征。但任何一个特征都不能单独区分所有近缘种：比较样本中的毛色会重叠，杂交个体也可能相似。下文从外观转向亲代照料、巴西报告记录和线粒体亲缘关系；每项研究回答的尺度各不相同。
text.en: White ear tufts and a pale forehead star stand out in descriptions of adult common marmosets. Neither feature alone separates every close relative: coat patterns overlap in comparative samples and hybrids. The studies below move from appearance to care, reported Brazilian records and mitochondrial relationships, each at a different scale.

title.en: A coat pattern described from adult samples
title.zh: 来自成体样本的毛色描述

text.en: From 2015 to 2019, a Brazilian study compared 30 adult C. jacchus with 209 adult Callithrix specimens drawn from both wild and captive sources. It described grey-tipped crown hairs, a grey chin, white ear tufts, a distinct forehead star and dark or grey dorsal bands over orange underfur. Yet the means of 13 measured traits did not differ significantly from C. penicillata in that sample. The description helps compare adults; it is not a stand-alone field test, especially where hybrids have overlapping coats.
text.zh: 2015 至 2019 年，一项巴西研究从野外与圈养混合来源的 209 只成年柽柳猴中，比较了 30 只普通狨。论文描述其额顶部前半段毛尖呈灰色、颏部灰色、耳周有蓬松白色耳簇、额头有明显星斑，背部黑色或灰白色上毛覆盖橙色底毛。不过在该成体样本里，13 项测量的均值与黑耳狨（C. penicillata）没有显著差异。这样的描述有助于比较成体，不是单独的野外鉴定法；杂交个体的毛色尤其可能重叠。

title.en: Native and introduced records in Brazil
title.zh: 巴西的原生与引入记录

text.en: In the study’s presence-only compilation, northeastern Brazil’s coastal and inland records were treated as native, while records from São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais were classified as introductions. Those observed locations are distinct from modeled habitat suitability. Together they describe the compiled records, not the species’ complete range, and they cannot establish absence from places with no record.
text.zh: 该研究汇编的是出现记录：作者将巴西东北部沿海和内陆记录列为原生区域，将圣保罗、巴拉那、里约热内卢和米纳斯吉拉斯记录列为引入区域。实际地点与模型预测的栖地适宜性是不同证据；这份资料只能描述已汇编记录，不能给出完整分布边界，也不能证明没有记录的地区不存在本种。

title.en: A captive study of fathers and infant outcomes
title.zh: 圈养研究中的父亲照料与幼体结果

text.en: At a Wisconsin research colony, investigators tested how 24 experienced fathers responded to infant distress calls and followed 62 offspring. Infants of fathers classed as responsive were more likely to survive beyond one month (p = 0.002); the paper also reported differences in group weights at weeks 28 and 30. Because this was one captive-colony study, the result is an association—not a wild survival estimate or proof that the response caused the outcome.
text.zh: 威斯康星一处研究圈养群体里，研究者记录了 24 位有育幼经验父亲对幼体求救叫声的反应，并追踪 62 只幼体。被归为会回应的父亲，其幼体超过一个月后存活的比例较高（p = 0.002）；论文还报告第 28 和 30 周的组间体重差异。由于研究只来自一个圈养群体，这是一项关联，不是野外存活率估算，也不能证明父亲的反应造成了结果。

title.en: What Brazilian rabies surveillance can show
title.zh: 巴西狂犬病监测能说明什么

text.en: Brazil’s Ministry of Health passive surveillance logged 67 rabies outbreaks affecting common marmosets—91 cases in 41 municipalities—from January 2008 through October 2020. The study also reported spillover of a Desmodus rotundus antigenic variant to C. jacchus in northern and southern reporting areas. These are reported outbreaks and a documented pathogen interaction, not a measure of rabies prevalence across the species’ range.
text.zh: 巴西卫生部被动监测在 2008 年 1 月至 2020 年 10 月间，记录 41 个市镇发生 67 起影响普通狨的狂犬病疫情，共 91 例。研究还报告吸血蝠（Desmodus rotundus）抗原变异株向普通狨溢出，涉及北部与南部报告区域。这些数字反映上报疫情和已识别的病原相互作用，并非对整个物种分布区患病率的测量。

title.en: A conservation question involving introduced relatives
title.zh: 引入近缘种带来的保育问题

text.en: Among 18 free-living marmosets with putative hybrid appearance from four southeastern Brazilian localities, five carried a maternal COX2 haplotype of C. jacchus. The authors discuss hybridization between threatened native C. aurita and introduced congeners, including the common marmoset, as a conservation concern. This small sample does not estimate hybridization frequency in C. jacchus, quantify population effects or establish the common marmoset’s conservation status.
text.zh: 在巴西东南部四地采集的 18 只自由活动、外形疑似杂交绒猴中，有 5 只带有普通狨母系 COX2 单倍型。论文将受威胁原生种 C. aurita 与包括普通狨在内的引入近缘种之间的杂交列为保育关注。不过，这一小样本没有估算普通狨种群的杂交频率或种群影响，也没有确定普通狨自身的保育状态。

title.en: A mitochondrial lineage estimate, not a species origin date
title.zh: 线粒体谱系估计不是物种起源日期

text.en: Combining 49 newly sequenced Callithrix mitogenomes with published sequences, one study estimated that its sampled C. jacchus and Caatinga C. penicillata lineages were sisters that diverged about 0.51 million years ago. That date belongs to the sampled mitochondrial lineages and model. It is neither a nuclear-genome species tree nor a definitive date for the origin of C. jacchus.
text.zh: 一项研究把新测序的 49 个柽柳猴属线粒体基因组与已发表序列合并，估计其取样的普通狨与黑耳狨卡廷加支系互为姐妹谱系，约在 51 万年前分化。这个时间属于特定的线粒体谱系样本和模型，不是核基因组物种树的日期，也不是普通狨确定的起源时间。

title.en: Malukiewicz et al. (2024). Pelage variation and morphometrics of closely related Callithrix marmoset species and their hybrids.
title.zh: Malukiewicz 等（2024）：近缘柽柳猴属物种及其杂交个体的毛色变异与形态测量。

scope.zh: 2015–2019 年巴西野生与圈养混合来源的成体表型和形态测量比较，不是完整的全生活史形态综述。

title.zh: Benavides 等（2022）：巴西普通狨狂犬病时空动态与栖地适宜性。

scope.zh: 巴西 2008–2020 年被动监测、出现记录及栖地适宜性模型；报告病例与模型预测分开解释。

title.zh: Ziegler、Sosa 与 Colman（2017）：父亲照料方式与普通狨幼体健康结果。

scope.zh: 威斯康星一处圈养研究群体；该研究设计不估计野外行为或存活率。

title.zh: Nogueira 等（2022）：用单亲遗传标记研究野生出生绒猴的杂交。

scope.en: Eighteen free-living putative hybrids from four southeastern Brazilian localities during 2004–2013; five carried the C. jacchus maternal haplotype.
scope.zh: 2004–2013 年巴西东南部四地的 18 只自由活动疑似杂交个体；其中 5 只带有普通狨母系单倍型。

readerLimitations.en: These linked studies cover selected source-backed topics, not a full species review. They do not provide a synthesis of wild diet, habitat use, locomotion, body size or lifespan, and they do not supply a current conservation assessment or population trend.
readerLimitations.zh: 这里串联的是几项有来源依据的主题，而非完整物种综述。现有材料不足以综合野外食性、栖地利用、运动方式、体型或寿命，也没有当前保育评估或种群趋势。

geography: Archaeological sample sites south of the Limpopo River across central and southern South Africa; 28 sampled individuals date to 10,200–150 calibrated years before present.

overview: The accepted name Homo sapiens covers a species history far wider than any one fossil or genome. Here, bones, cave chemistry and ancient DNA open several different windows; each has its own place, dating method and limits.

ecology.diet: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, collagen isotopes from 10 human remains, interpreted with 52 animal remains, indicated a large-terrestrial-mammal diet in a cold steppe–tundra setting. This single cave sample does not describe Homo sapiens generally.

evidenceSummary: The examples range from two Tam Pà Ling fossils and a Ranis diet study to one Siberian genome and a southern African genomic sample. Their ages and methods answer different questions; together they do not reveal a complete species range, origin date or migration history.

title.en: Different materials answer different questions
title.zh: 不同材料回答不同问题

text.zh: 额骨碎片、胫骨近端、古基因组和骨胶原同位素，提供了了解古代智人的不同证据。老挝化石依靠周边沉积物估算年代，西伯利亚股骨经过直接测年，德国洞穴中的胶原则用于分析饮食信号。每项结果都应与材料、方法和地点对应，不能把不同观察拼成一条连续历史。
text.en: A frontal-bone fragment, a proximal tibia, ancient genomes and collagen isotopes are different kinds of evidence about ancient Homo sapiens. The Laos fossils have ages estimated from surrounding sediments; a Siberian femur was directly dated; and cave collagen from Germany was analyzed for dietary signals. Keeping each result tied to its material, method and place prevents separate observations from turning into one continuous story.

title.en: No single study covers the species' history
title.zh: 没有一项研究覆盖整个物种历史

text.en: The name Homo sapiens is the accepted species name in the pinned COL26.8 checklist. The studies here examine particular fossils, archaeological settings and population-genomic samples. They address different questions and cannot be combined into a complete account of human origins, present-day diversity or migration.
text.zh: 固定版 COL26.8 清单接受 Homo sapiens 这一物种名。这里的研究考察特定化石、考古环境和群体基因组样本，回答的问题各不相同，不能拼成完整的人类起源、当代多样性或迁徙叙事。

title.en: How old are the Tam Pà Ling fossils?
title.zh: Tam Pà Ling 化石有多老？

text.en: At Tam Pà Ling cave in northern Laos, the study attributes TPL 6, a left frontal-bone fragment, and TPL 7, the upper end of a left tibia, to H. sapiens. Models based on surrounding sediments estimate 70 ± 3 thousand years for TPL 6 and as old as 77 ± 9 thousand years for TPL 7. These are contextual estimates rather than direct dates on the bones; the authors note that TPL 7 may be older still, and alteration after burial limits its measurement.
text.zh: 老挝北部 Tam Pà Ling 洞穴中的 TPL 6 是左额骨碎片，TPL 7 是左胫骨上端，论文将两者归为 H. sapiens。依据周边沉积物的模型估计，TPL 6 年代为 70 ± 3 千年，TPL 7 最早可达 77 ± 9 千年。这些是背景年代估计，并非骨骼直接测年；作者指出 TPL 7 可能更早，且埋藏后的改造限制了测量。

title.en: What the Ranis cave samples say about diet
title.zh: Ranis 洞穴样本显示了什么饮食信号？

text.en: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, Germany, researchers measured stable isotopes in collagen—a protein preserved in bone—from 10 human remains and compared them with 52 animal remains from the same archaeological setting. The results point to a diet dominated by large land mammals in a cold steppe–tundra environment. The layers date to about 47,500–45,770 and 46,820–43,260 calibrated years before present; those ages are not direct dates for each human bone. One cave cannot define human diets generally.
text.zh: 德国 Ranis 的 Ilsenhöhle 洞穴中，研究者测量了 10 份人类遗骸骨胶原中的稳定同位素——一种保存在骨骼蛋白里的化学信号，并与同一考古环境的 52 份动物遗骸比较。结果指向寒冷草原—苔原环境中以大型陆生哺乳动物为主的饮食。地层年代约为距今 47,500–45,770 年和 46,820–43,260 年（校正值），不是每块人骨的直接年代。一处洞穴不能代表一般人类饮食。

title.en: A genomic comparison south of the Limpopo
title.zh: 林波波河以南的基因组比较

text.en: One whole-genome study analyzed 28 people from archaeological sites south of the Limpopo River in central and southern Africa, spanning 10,200 to 150 calibrated years before present. In that study's comparison panel, samples older than 1,400 years fell outside the genetic-variation range represented by its modern-human samples and carried many variants the authors classified as specific to H. sapiens. The result depends on which individuals and modern comparison samples were included and how the authors defined those variants.
text.zh: 一项全基因组研究分析了林波波河以南、非洲中部和南部考古地点的 28 名个体，样本年代跨度为距今 10,200 至 150 个校准年。在该研究的比较面板中，早于 1,400 年的样本落在其现生人类样本所代表的遗传变异范围之外，并带有许多作者归类为 H. sapiens 特异的变异。结果取决于所采样个体、现生比较组和作者对变异的定义。

title.en: One directly dated person from Ust’-Ishim
title.zh: 一位经直接测年的 Ust’-Ishim 个体

text.en: The Ust’-Ishim 1 femur from western Siberia has a direct radiocarbon age of 46,880–43,210 calibrated years before present at 95.4% probability. The genome comes from this one person. This date does not give the origin of H. sapiens or the species' first and last appearances.
text.zh: 来自西西伯利亚的 Ust’-Ishim 1 股骨经直接放射性碳测年，95.4% 概率区间为距今 46,880–43,210 个校准年。基因组对应这一名受测者。该年代不是 H. sapiens 的起源时间，也不是物种首末出现范围。

title.en: These sites do not form one migration route
title.zh: 这些地点不能连成一条迁徙路线

text.en: The Laos fossils, Ranis diet signal, Siberian individual and southern African genomes differ in place, dating method and research question. They offer several views of ancient H. sapiens, but they do not trace one continuous migration route or define the species' current geographic range.
text.zh: 老挝化石、Ranis 饮食信号、西伯利亚个体和南部非洲古基因组，地点、年代方法和研究问题都不同。它们提供了观察古代 H. sapiens 的若干窗口，却不能组成一条连续迁徙路线，也不能说明该物种当前的完整地理分布。

readerLimitations.en: These examples cover only the fossils and datasets named above. They do not describe all living populations, the species' full life history, present-day range or origin. Sediment-based estimates, direct fossil dates and genomic comparisons have different meanings and should remain distinct.
